content:
Earlier this year, Twelve South launched the all-new Valet accessory, describing it as a "wireless charging stand and personal items organizer tray."

Twelve South has now expanded the Valet lineup with a more compact model supporting MagSafe and Qi2.2 wireless charging, with charging power of up to 25W.

The original Valet announced earlier this year measured 7.5 inches, providing enough space to hold your phone, keys, wallet, glasses and more. The new version, however, has been significantly reduced in size to 4.25 inches.

Below is Twelve South's description of the Valet's ultimate premium design:

The Valet is first and foremost a beautiful home accessory, and only then a precision wireless charger. It combines warm materials with modern craftsmanship to create a calmer, more thoughtful form that fits anywhere in the home—from the entryway table, to the kitchen, to the bedside table. The soft square charging pad echoes the architectural lines of the leather tray, while a weighted zinc-alloy base keeps everything stable and organized.

In terms of functionality, the smaller Valet has ample power to charge your iPhone. It also features a built-in additional USB-C port for charging your other accessories:

  • Up to 25W Qi2.2 wireless charging
  • Premium Nappa leather organizer tray
  • Four configurable orientations
  • Interchangeable, detachable leather frame
  • Weighted zinc-alloy base with built-in hidden cable management
  • Additional USB-C port supporting up to 10W wired charging
  • 45W power supply and 1.5m USB-C cable included

The 4.25-inch Twelve South Valet is available to order from today at a price of US$129.99, available in three color combinations. Although the price is not cheap, it is definitely an attractive and practical charging and storage space, allowing you to charge your phone while also holding glasses, wallet or keys.
